adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` appends other hosts’ destination calendars to `evt.destinationCalendar` (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`). However, when persisting the booking, it still only connects `destinationCalendar[0]` (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so the additional per-host destination calendars are not stored on the booking. Later “approval/confirm” flows rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` solely from `booking.destinationCalendar` or `user.destinationCalendar` (e.g., `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts` wraps `booking.destinationCalendar` into a single-element array), meaning only the main host calendar can be targeted during approval and the other hosts’ calendars won’t receive events. This is a concrete correctness gap visible from the diff.
